debug_train_center_net: debug CenterNet training by visualizing ground truth heatmaps, positive indices, and regression targets on input images
debug_test_center_net: debug CenterNet inference by visualizing predicted heatmaps, bounding boxes, and class labels on test images
debug_second_stage_proposals: debug second stage detection by visualizing predicted or ground truth boxes and object proposals on images
get_color_image_heatmap: create a color image from a heatmap tensor by multiplying with pregenerated random colors
blend_image_heatmaps: blend multiple heatmap color maps onto an image using alpha compositing and maximum merging
